**RE: Member Appeal of Prior Authorization Denial**
* **Member Name:** Rowan Jennings
* **Member ID:** W965543948
* **Plan:** Ambetter from Magnolia Health (Commercial/ACA)
* **Requested Service:** Neck (cervical) fusion (ACDF)
* **CPT Code:** 22551
* **Provider:** Dr. Duval, MD, Orthopedic Surgery
* **Reference Number:** POC-AAA1CF805A-66883
* **Denial Date:** August 14, 2026

Dear Appeal Review Committee,

I am writing to formally appeal the denial of the prior authorization request for a single-level anterior cervical discectomy and fusion (ACDF), CPT code 22551, to be performed by Dr. Duval. 

The denial letter states that "the imaging findings submitted do not support the medical necessity of the requested procedure." This determination is clinically incorrect and directly contradicted by my medical records when evaluated under the governing medical policy: **Evolent Clinical Guideline 1759 for Cervical Spine Surgery** (Effective July 1, 2026 – July 1, 2027).

Below, we demonstrate how my clinical presentation and objective imaging results satisfy every requirement of the policy criteria.

### 1. Objective Imaging Evidence of Nerve Root Compression
Under Evolent Clinical Guideline 1759, a single-level ACDF is indicated when:
> "Imaging studies confirm the presence of spinal cord or spinal nerve root compression (disc herniation or foraminal stenosis) at the level corresponding with the clinical findings. Imaging studies may include: o MRI (preferred study for assessing cervical spine soft tissue)"

**Clinical Mapping:**
* An MRI of my cervical spine performed on **2026-06-07** explicitly reveals a **C5-C6 disc herniation with severe right foraminal narrowing and C6 nerve root compression**. 
* This advanced imaging provides clear, objective evidence of severe, localized nerve root compression at C5-C6, satisfying the imaging criteria.

### 2. Correlation with Clinical Findings and Radiculopathy
The policy requires the presence of:
> "Cervical radiculopathy or myelopathy from ruptured disc, spondylosis, spinal instability, or deformity"

And states that:
> "All operative interventions must be based on a positive correlation with clinical findings, the natural history of the disease, the clinical course, and diagnostic tests or imaging results."

**Clinical Mapping:**
* My clinical presentation is a textbook correlation with the C5-C6 disc herniation and C6 nerve root compression imaged on my MRI.
* I have experienced 12 months of progressive neck pain, accompanied by classic C6 radicular symptoms: **radicular pain and numbness radiating into my right thumb and index finger, alongside weakness**.
* On physical examination, Dr. Duval documented **positive provocative testing on the affected right side** and a **neurologic deficit directly corresponding to the C5-C6 level**. There is a perfect clinical correlation between my physical symptoms and the nerve root compression shown on my 2026-06-07 MRI.

### 3. Exhaustive Failure of Conservative Care
The policy requires:
> "Failure of conservative treatment* for a minimum of six (6) weeks within the last six (6) months"

**Clinical Mapping:**
* **Supervised Physical Therapy:** I completed 10 weeks of structured, supervised physical therapy (including cervical traction and postural training) from **2026-04-10 to 2026-06-19**, totaling 16 completed visits. This is fully documented in my physical therapy discharge note. This 10-week course took place within the last six months and far exceeds the policy's 6-week minimum.
* **Medications:** I have taken NSAIDs for 8 months with inadequate relief. 
* **Interventional Treatment:** I received a cervical corticosteroid injection on **2026-04-23**, which provided only 4 weeks of partial relief before my severe pain and radicular symptoms returned.

### Summary
The clinical records demonstrate that I have a clear, matching surgical plan for a single-level ACDF at C5-C6. My MRI dated 2026-06-07 objectively confirms severe C6 nerve root compression that perfectly correlates with my right-sided radiculopathy, numbness, and weakness. Because I have completed and failed 10 weeks of supervised physical therapy, months of oral medications, and an epidural injection, I have met all conservative and imaging criteria outlined in **Evolent Clinical Guideline 1759**.

I request that you immediately reverse this denial and approve the requested ACDF (CPT 22551) so that I may proceed with this medically necessary surgery.

Please contact my provider, Dr. Duval, at [Provider Phone Number] if you require any additional information. Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Sincerely,

Rowan Jennings
